title: Nohitatu Technologies Overview
text: Nohitatu Technologies Private Limited is a global software development agency and SaaS partner specializing in custom enterprise software, healthcare RCM, medical billing, cloud products, and mobile app development. We help global clients scale engineering teams, modernize legacy platforms, and build tailored digital products.

title: Custom Software Development & Cloud SaaS
text: Nohitatu delivers custom full-stack software development, cloud-native SaaS engineering, legacy system modernization, and ongoing software maintenance. We build scalable applications tailored to business roadmaps using React, Next.js, Python, Node.js, Flutter, and AWS/Azure cloud infrastructure.

title: Healthcare Software, Medical Billing & RCM
text: Nohitatu provides specialized Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and medical billing software. Capabilities include automated 837P / CMS-1500 claim processing, eligibility verification, charge entry, denial management, and HIPAA-compliant healthcare analytics dashboards for health-tech platforms and providers.

title: Hire Dedicated Developers & Engineering Teams
text: You can hire pre-vetted senior dedicated software developers, mobile app engineers, and UI/UX designers from Nohitatu. We offer flexible engagement models (Dedicated Team, Time & Material, Fixed Price) with rapid onboarding in 3 to 7 business days, integrating directly with your tools and product roadmap.

title: Nohitatu Products & Portfolio
text: Nohitatu has built 29+ products including: CMS 1500 Medical Billing, Sales CRM, Dojoman Event Management software, Healthcare CRM, HR & Payroll Suite, Task Management App, FinTechesh Financial Suite, WorkPlace Safety Mobile App, Taxation App, and Manamakkal Matrimonial Platform. Explore our full portfolio at Portfolio.html.
